mines.mine_notes: stream: gold purchase agreement; monthly deliveries equal to the greater of 1.26% of produced gold or 350 oz; ongoing payment 20% of the prevailing market price per oz (non-cash partial settlement of the interest on delivery). Operator Equinox Gold; accounted for at fair value through profit/loss (FVTPL). FY2025: stream sales US$14.425M; change in fair value of the Greenstone gold interest +US$32.922M. Q4 2025 attributable deliveries 1,050 GEOs. Carrying value US$72.844M (non-current) + US$10.784M (current) at Dec 31, 2025. ownership_pct shown is the stream percentage.

royalty: 2.7% NSR until 2.5 Moz of gold produced, then 0.45% NSR on the next 1.5 Moz. Operator West African Resources. Operating (first full operational quarter in Q4 2025). FY2025 royalty revenue US$8.101M. Carrying value US$57.138M. Acquired from B2Gold (first closing Jun 5, 2024). ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.

royalty: 2.7% NSR until royalty payments total US$22.5M, then 0.45% NSR until 1.5 Moz of gold produced. Operator West African Resources. Construction/near-term: prestripping commenced; ore delivery to the Sanbrado processing plant on schedule for early Q3 2026. Nondepletable carrying value US$11.205M. Acquired from B2Gold (first closing Jun 5, 2024). ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.

royalty: 0.21% NSR on a portion of Artemis Gold's Blackwater gold project, BC (acquired from Sandstorm, closed Nov 30, 2023). Operating. FY2025 royalty revenue US$1.209M. Carrying value US$7.217M. ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.

royalty: 2.0% NSR on the producing Mercedes gold mine, Sonora. Operator Highlander Silver (acquired Bear Creek Mining and the Mercedes mine Feb 26, 2026). Operating. FY2025 royalty revenue US$2.090M. Impaired US$8.4M in FY2024 (recoverable amount US$6.2M) after Bear Creek's Jan 2025 R&R downgrade; no impairment in 2025. Depletable carrying value US$5.321M. Acquired from Equinox Gold (2022 Sandbox launch). ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.

POST-FY2025 ACQUISITION (announced Apr 6, 2026): stream on 3.52% of payable gold over life of mine from Orion/Blackstone for US$360M (US$340M cash + US$20M in shares); ongoing payment 10% of spot; uncapped. Stream completion tests required by Sep 30, 2027, else the stream percentage ratchets up. Operator Skeena Resources. Construction: ~49% complete; first production targeted Q2 2027 at ~10,000 oz/yr attributable (years 1-5). ownership_pct shown is the stream percentage.

stream: 90% of payable silver from the Rosh Pinah zinc mine; operator Appian Capital Advisory; acquired 2025. Operating: inaugural silver delivery in Q4 2025. FY2025 stream sales US$2.416M. Carrying value US$84.752M. ownership_pct shown is the stream percentage; attributable silver ounces not separately disclosed.

royalty: 1.0% NSR on the producing Pilar gold mine in Goiás, Brazil, owned by Pilar Gold Inc. (acquired from Equinox Gold at the 2022 Sandbox launch). Depletable carrying value US$3.350M. No FY2025 revenue disclosed separately for this asset. ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.

royalty: 0.5% NSR on the Cuiu Cuiu gold project owned by Cabral Gold Inc., Pará, Brazil (a 1.0% NSR on a portion of the project was also acquired from Sandstorm). Construction: Phase 1 gold-oxide heap leach project ~54% complete at Mar 2026, on budget and on schedule; commissioning Q3 2026, commercial production Q4 2026. Reclassified from Exploration & Evaluation to depletable in FY2025 (demonstrated technical feasibility/commercial viability). FY2025 royalty revenue US$0.250M; carrying value US$2.070M. ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.

royalty: 1.0% NSR on the Converse gold development project in Nevada, owned by Waterton Global Resource Management (acquired from Sandstorm at the 2022 Sandbox launch). Exploration & Evaluation carrying value US$4.391M. ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.

royalty: 2.0% NSR on the Hackett River silver-zinc-copper development project, Nunavut, owned by Glencore (acquired from Sandstorm at the 2022 Sandbox launch). Exploration & Evaluation carrying value US$14.716M. ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate; byproduct flagged (Ag-Zn-Cu).

royalty: 1.2% NSR on the Prairie Creek zinc-silver-lead development project, Northwest Territories, owned by NorZinc (acquired from Sandstorm at the 2022 Sandbox launch). Exploration & Evaluation carrying value US$7.514M. ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate; byproduct flagged (Zn-Ag-Pb).

royalty: 2.0% NSR on the primary claims plus 1.0% NSR on periphery claims over the Golden Sidewalk gold project in Ontario, owned by Prosper Gold Corp. Exploration stage. Acquired from B2Gold (second closing Aug 13, 2024). No carrying value disclosed separately in the FS asset table (likely within 'Other' US$904k or immaterial). ownership_pct shown is the primary-claim royalty rate.

royalty: 1.5% NSR on the gold-copper Primavera project, Nicaragua. Exploration & Evaluation carrying value US$1.391M. Acquired from B2Gold (first closing Jun 5, 2024). ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.

stream: copper stream on Endeavour Silver's operating Huachocolpa Uno mine (Kolpa), Peru; acquired Apr 2025 for US$35.0M upfront. Versamet buys the greater of 95.8% of copper produced and 0.03 lb Cu per lb of produced lead until 6,000 t delivered, then 71.85%; after 10,500 t delivered, 47.9% of LOM copper. Ongoing payment 10% of spot. FY2025 stream sales US$3.860M. Carrying value US$32.863M. Included as a base-metal stream for completeness (non-precious); ownership_pct shown is the initial stream percentage.

royalty: polymetallic royalty on the operating Santa Rita nickel-copper mine, Brazil; operator Appian Capital Advisory; acquired 2025. FY2025 royalty revenue US$2.410M. Carrying value US$38.488M. Included for completeness (non-precious Ni-Cu mine); rate not disclosed in the FS.

royalty: 1.0% gross revenue royalty (GRR) on the El Pilar copper project, Mexico, owned by Southern Copper Corp. (acquired from Sandstorm, 2023). Nondepletable carrying value US$17.490M. Included for completeness (non-precious, copper); ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.

royalty: 1.0% NSR on the Vittangi graphite development project, Sweden, owned by Talga Group (acquired from Sandstorm at the 2022 Sandbox launch). Nondepletable carrying value US$15.000M. Included for completeness (non-precious, graphite); ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.

royalty: 2.0% NSR on the Mocoa copper-molybdenum project, Colombia, owned by Libero Copper & Gold Corp. Exploration & Evaluation carrying value US$10.000M. Acquired from B2Gold (second closing Aug 13, 2024). Included for completeness (non-precious); ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.

royalty: 0.4% NSR on the Mason copper-gold development project, Nevada, owned by Hudbay Minerals (acquired from Sandstorm at the 2022 Sandbox launch). Exploration & Evaluation carrying value US$4.876M. Included for completeness (copper-dominant); ownership_pct shown is the royalty rate.

GROUPED: small non-material interests with combined carrying value US$904k, including a 1.0% NSR on a portion of the Ajax copper-gold project (BC), a 1.0% NSR on the Buffelsfontein gold project (South Africa) and a 2.0% NSR on the Wiluna uranium project (Australia) acquired from Sandstorm at the 2022 Sandbox launch.

notes: Diversified metals royalty/streaming company; formerly Sandbox Royalties Corp. Fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2025, all amounts USD. Listing status VERIFIED: the FY2025 audited financial statements (approved by the Board Mar 12, 2026) state the common shares trade on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX) in Canada and the Nasdaq in the United States under the symbol 'VMET'. Incorporated Jan 24, 2011 under the BC Business Corporations Act; 5-for-1 share consolidation took effect Sep 12, 2025. Head office: Suite 3200, 733 Seymour St, Vancouver, BC, Canada V6B 0S6. FY2025: total revenue US$34.761M (stream sales US$20.701M + royalty revenue US$14.060M); net income US$20.332M (incl. US$32.922M fair-value gain on the Greenstone gold interest); record attributable GEOs 9,815 (+94% y/y); adjusted EBITDA US$23.0M; operating cash flow before working capital US$24.7M. 2026 guidance: 20,000-23,000 GEOs. Per-asset FY2025 revenue (FS Note 13): Greenstone sales US$14.425M; Kiaka US$8.101M; Kolpa sales US$3.860M; Mercedes US$2.090M; Rosh Pinah sales US$2.416M; Santa Rita US$2.410M; Blackwater US$1.209M; Cuiú Cuiú US$0.250M. Inaugural 2025 revenues from Kiaka, Blackwater, Kolpa, Rosh Pinah and Santa Rita. No impairment charges in 2025 (Mercedes was impaired US$8.4M in 2024). Credit facilities: US$171M drawn at Dec 31, 2025 (US$30M current); RCF upsized to US$200M + US$25M accordion on Mar 4, 2026 with the term loan fully repaid. Post-FY2025: 3.52% gold stream on Skeena Resources' Eskay Creek (BC) acquired Apr 2026 for US$360M (US$340M cash + US$20M shares), completion tests by Sep 30, 2027. Base-metal/non-precious interests (Kolpa copper stream, Santa Rita Ni-Cu royalty, El Pilar copper GRR, Vittangi graphite, Mocoa Cu-Mo, Mason Cu-Au) are included in the mines list for completeness with byproduct flags, consistent with the RGLD precedent (Red Chris, Khoemacau). Attributable per-asset ounces not disclosed (royaltyco).
